title: First public beta
changes: Use the responsive client workspace with documents, projects and equipment organized by site.
Manage cameras, desktops and servers, and export camera inventories by site.
Organize documents with category and site tags, retain previous versions and download file history.
Create maintenance checklists with individual equipment confirmation, comments and evidence photos.
Capture evidence from a mobile camera and view photos in the shared gallery.
Install Assets Control on your device and download projects with current documents for offline consultation.
Queue maintenance photos and hardware report photos from downloaded projects for upload when connectivity and a valid session are available.
Use the redesigned dashboard, user management and report pages.
